scope: Desktop source-data responsiveness, navigation motion and app-level persistent MCS connection

websiteBoundary.profile: Current-account nickname/avatar are not exposed in the developer contract. Per user instruction, defer integration until the site provides that endpoint; display an explicit site-account placeholder, never a blueprint author or stale local user.
websiteBoundary.ownerCount: GET /api/v1/account/blueprints?page=1&limit=1; totalCount is optional in cursor mode, so request offset pagination explicitly.

implementation.source: Dedicated worker retains the full typed NBT document. The main thread receives at most 100 child summaries per request and renders a virtual tree. Scalar/subtree edits use bounded SNBT text; save serializes the complete document, including unseen pages. Filtering explicitly applies to expanded fields.
implementation.editing: Node editing retains Byte/Short/Int/Long/Float/Double and typed-array semantics. Oversized subtree editing directs the user to smaller child nodes. Failed saves keep the dirty state and allow retry.
implementation.motion: 240 ms incoming transitions; 14 px shift for lightweight routes, opacity-only for fixed/heavy routes, no fully transparent frame. Sidebar indicator uses measured item position and contrasting on-primary colour. Reduced-motion preference is respected.
implementation.connection: App-wide home/sidebar/library connection dialog. Per the user's revised multi-platform requirement, persist verified connections in the native SQLite site_connections table. Native restore returns status only, not the key. Offline preserves credentials; revoked authentication clears private UI state. Explicit disconnect clears the key and retains a NULL migration marker. Database copies contain sensitive connection data and must not be published.
implementation.otherPlatforms: All platforms use the same SQLite schema and persistence path. Windows Credential Manager is read/removed only for one-time migration from earlier builds; there are no new vault writes. No credentials are placed in frontend profiles, configuration, URLs or logs.
implementation.sourceFix: fastsnbt 0.2.1 preserves empty compound delimiters, including consecutive empty list entries. Frontend save uses quoted keys, compact lists, signed typed byte/long arrays and explicit floating-point literals to retain native NBT types. Removed the source-view explanatory paragraph.

verification.connectionPersistenceTests: Isolated SQLite tests cover reopening, repeated schema initialization, failed writes, legacy migration ordering, disconnect markers, invalid records and reset. Browser tests use fake credentials only.
verification.sourceNativeRoundtrip: Explicitly ran the default-ignored cross-runtime test on a local blueprint without writing it, plus a synthetic scalar/array/empty-object fixture. Native SNBT to frontend document to saved SNBT to native Value preserves every value and type. Browser fixture expansion/edit/save also preserves empty objects and the full 413280-element array.
verification.desktopBuild: Normal mcSchematic profile: node scripts/tauri-run.cjs build --debug --no-bundle passed. Existing Rust warnings and Vite large-chunk warnings remain.

sourceBrowserFixture.environment: Playwright Chromium, local Vite dev server, 1600x1000. Route modules already loaded, fresh document and worker; native IPC mocked. Not a real-account or packaged-WebView performance benchmark.

navigationBrowserFixture.theme: grey_dark with custom background and 0.84 surface opacity
navigationBrowserFixture.note: Cold page module/render work can still cause longer frames; do not claim universal 60 fps.

verification.connectionBrowserFixture: Verified fake-key restore after reload, home-to-mine navigation using authenticated API, offline vs invalid-key UI, private rows cleared on invalid authentication, and explicit disconnect remaining disconnected after reload. No real API key used.
verification.reducedMotion: Sidebar indicator computed transition duration is 0s when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
verification.productionDatabase: Unchanged during verification; no user credentials or database contents are included in this report.
